name: evp-public-data-mcp
description: Curated public data extraction for marketplaces, government data, filings, trials, and research.
long_description: EVP Public Data gives AI assistants focused tools for structured public data. Search WordPress plugins, Zapier apps, Atlassian Marketplace apps, VS Code extensions, Apple Podcasts charts, Steam games, Grants.gov opportunities, USAspending awards, ClinicalTrials.gov studies, and SEC EDGAR filings. Every tool returns clean JSON with source links and caps each call at 25 records to control cost.

apify_token.title: Apify API token
apify_token.description: Token used to run the underlying pay-per-event public data extractors. Stored by the MCP client and never committed to this package.
